body_lead: HYDERABAD: At a time when AI is the buzzword, the gap between policy intent and classroom reality is shocking — only 21% of government schools in Telangana have computer facilities despite the state introducing coding and artificial intelligence (AI) into the curriculum for Classes 1 to 9. Midway through the academic year, regular classes in coding, AI and related digital subjects have largely not begun in government and local body schools, teachers said.
